To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fusion of the Cas9 nucleased with homology-directed repair effectors, such as CtIP, Rad51C, and Rad52, enhances the ratio of HDR over non-homologus end joining in human cells by 1.5 to 2-fold.

the Cas9 fusion with homologous recombination factors and the use of a guide RNA with MS2-binding loops promote homology-directed repair of double-strand breaks in mammalian cells and significantly reduce the non-homologus end-joining events.
the fusion of Cas9 with proteins that promote homologous recombination enhances the ratio of homology-directed repair to nonhomologous end joining events by a factor of four to 15.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of novel tools and technologies for genome editing in human cells.
the development of new tools for the enhancement of precise gene modifications in human cells.
the development of a novel method to improve the efficiency of gene editing in mammalian systems by enhancing homology-directed repair.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the fusion proteins of Cas 9 with CtIP, Mre11, and Rad52, as well as the association of Cas9 with MS2-CtI P, but not the Cas9-Sun Tag, promote HDR up to 6-fold and significantly reduce N HEJ events in human cells.
the fusion of CtIP with Cas9 and the use of MS2-CtIp as a separate component are the most effective strategies to increase the efficiency of precise gene modification in mammalian cells.

the fusion of the Cas9 nucleased with the homologous recombination factors CtIP, Mre11, Rad52, Rad51C and Rad51D, and the association of the fusion with a guide RNA including MS2 binding loops, significantly increase the HDR/NHEI ratio.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Cas9 fusions and the MS2 approach increase HDR/NHEJ ratios, while the SunTag system is less efficient.
we have developed a simple and effective approach to enhance precise gene modifications by promoting HDR in human cells.
the Cas9 nucleasedomain can be fused with proteins promoting homology directed repair to enhance the HDR efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a fusion protein of Cas9 and a homologous recombination effector protein, such as CtIP, can significantly enhance precise gene editing by homology-directed DNA repair (HDR).
the use of Cas9 fusions or MS2 binding loops to recruit homologous recombination factors to the Cas9 nucleased can be used to enhance HDR for improving genome editing in human cells.
Cas9 can be used in a fusion protein with different proteins involved in the HDR process to promote precise gene modification in mammalian cells.
